c74object.name: evi.list.interp
c74object.digest: Manually or automatically interpolate between previous and current list
c74object.description: A simple abstraction wrapper for interpolating between a previous and a new list input, with controls for slide up and slide down rates. Can be triggered manually, or automatically via an internal qmetro.

inlet.digest: list to interpolate, bang retriggers most recent list, int turns auto mode on/off
inlet.description: Send a list into this inlet and it will be interpolated to from the previously held list. Int 0/1 turns internal metro off/on.
Value over which to slide up the interpolation. A value of '1.' would mean no list interpolation.
Value over which to slide down the interpolation. A value of '1.' would mean no list interpolation.

outlet.description: The list result of the interpolation.

objarg.name: SlideUp
objarg.description: Value over which to slide up the interpolation. A value of '1.' would mean no list interpolation.

objarg.name: SlideDown
objarg.description: Value over which to slide down the interpolation. A value of '1.' would mean no list interpolation.

objarg.name: UpdateRate
objarg.description: Internal qmetro update rate in ms.

attribute.name: listinit
attribute.description: By default the initial list on load is a list of 256 zeros, updated when receiving the first list in the left inlet. With this attribute you can set the value used to create the initial list to any float.

attribute.name: maxsize
attribute.description: Maximum list size on which to operate. Reduce this to save resources as the default is the maximum.

attribute.name: qmetro
attribute.description: Messages to internal qmetro for automatic list interpolation, such as '@qmetro active 1'.

attribute.name: slide_down
attribute.description: Value over which to slide down the interpolation. Attribute wins out over argument. A value of '1.' would mean no list interpolation.

attribute.name: slide_up
attribute.description: Value over which to slide up the interpolation. Attribute wins out over argument. A value of '1.' would mean no list interpolation.

attribute.name: update
attribute.description: Update rate of internal qmetro (if active), set in any time syntax qmetro understands (default 33 ms).

c74object.discussion: Thanks to Vincent Goudard who made the original version of this abstraction.
